mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent ( id, name, role, api_key, model_type, model_config, specialization_slug, status, score, access_type, capabilities, labels, last_seen_at, last_active_at, online_status, offline_reason, offline_at, deleted, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{role}, #{apiKey}, #{modelType}, #{modelConfig,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{specializationSlug}, #{status}, #{score}, #{accessType}, #{capabilities,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{labels,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{lastSeenAt}, #{lastActiveAt}, #{onlineStatus}, #{offlineReason}, #{offlineAt}, #{deleted}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE agent SET name = #{et.name}, role = #{et.role}, api_key = #{et.apiKey}, model_type = #{et.modelType}, model_config = #{et.modelConfig,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, specialization_slug = #{et.specializationSlug}, status = #{et.status}, score = #{et.score}, access_type = #{et.accessType}, capabilities = #{et.capabilities,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, labels = #{et.labels,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, last_seen_at = #{et.lastSeenAt}, last_active_at = #{et.lastActiveAt}, online_status = #{et.onlineStatus}, offline_reason = #{et.offlineReason}, offline_at = #{et.offlineAt}, update_by = #{et.updateBy}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE id = #{et.id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent WHERE (last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < #{cutoff}) AND (online_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'SLEEPING') AND deleted = 0
